text: Kaneka Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (code 4118). Its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 are The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 11.26%), Nippon Life Insurance Company (5.17%), Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (4.88%) and Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company (4.69%), with banks, insurers and trust accounts below 5% thereafter; in its shareholder composition, government and local public authorities hold 0.4 thousand shares (one holder).
short: Kaneka is Tokyo-listed; its largest holders are trust-bank accounts, life insurers and banks (Master Trust 11.26%, Nippon Life 5.17%).
